nom: Clinique UV Solutions Brightening + Tinted Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 50/PA+++

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin say the dewy finish can look too glowy or shiny and needs a mattifying powder on top, describing a heavier sheen than they wanted, though one still found the light coverage useful for camouflaging redness and pimples.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are mostly positive, saying the tint doesn't cling to dry patches and leaves skin looking plumped and moisturized rather than flat; a few still say it feels drying on its own or doesn't wear as long on very dry skin, and recommend a moisturizer underneath first.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including combination-dry and combination-acne-prone skin, generally report good results and no breakouts, though one — a 55-year-old with combination skin — found the texture too thick and shiny to fully settle even under powder.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly say it doesn't irritate their skin or eyes and works well, but a couple specifically flag the niacinamide in the formula as not agreeing with sensitive skin, with one recommending sensitive users avoid it for that reason.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal-to-dry skin liked the thin, non-streaky texture but found the tint's coverage too minimal to hide blemishes, redness or dark spots.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, say the formula feels hydrating and doesn't cling to dry patches, leaving skin looking plumped rather than flat; a few reviewers report the opposite, saying it left their skin feeling very dry, flaky, or slightly drying, with one recommending a moisturizer underneath first.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the sheer tint visibly softens the look of redness, but one reviewer specifically notes the coverage is too light to actually camouflage redness, blemishes or dark spots.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with melasma specifically relies on this sunscreen's tint to help protect against further dark spots without leaving a cast, and another says the light tint helps camouflage acne marks, though a different reviewer says the coverage isn't enough to actually hide dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers, including combination-acne-prone skin, consistently report no new breakouts after switching to this sunscreen, and a couple say the light tint also helps camouflage existing acne marks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently say the dewy, glowy finish reads as too shiny or heavy for their skin and needs a mattifying powder on top, with a couple suggesting the formula suits normal-to-dry skin better than oily skin.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, blends across skin tones
Runny formula, easy to dispense too much
Sheer coverage, not a foundation substitute
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Narrow shade range for some skin tones
Harder to fully remove than typical sunscreen

extraits.titre: Loved The Tint, Not The Finish
extraits.texte: I'm a 55-year-old Black woman with combination skin, a light-to-medium brown complexion with warm undertones, and a consistent, detailed skincare routine — so I know how a product should layer. The shade match here is genuinely excellent, blending with no cast. My issue is the texture: it's very thick and leaves a shiny finish that never settled, even under powder foundation and finishing powder. I wanted to love the SPF 50 protection, but the heavy feel keeps this at 3 out of 5 stars. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been trying this Clinique UV Solutions brightening & tinted SPF50 for a little over two weeks now and I have mixed opinions. (To note I have normal to dry skin) I really like the texture and consistency of the product, it's very thin and almost liquidy but I think that is why it applies so well without streaks and it has a good amount of slip to it, so it doesn't settle into any of my fine lines. I've applied it using a brush, sponge & with my fingers like I would a moisturizer and all have worked. It's great for days when I don't have a lot of time but I still want to wear something. The finish is more of a luminous satin, it gives a healthy glow (with no shimmer or glitter) but if you have oily skin it may be too glowy for you. Where I have the mixed feelings is when it comes to the tint & coverage. I have shade light and while it doesn't make me look pale or washed out, I really don't see much coverage at all. It may even out my skin the tiniest bit but it's not something that will cover blemishes, redness or dark spots. It's perfect for the 'no makeup' look. The SPF hasn't clogged my pores or made me break out and it easily breaks down/washes off without leaving a residue behind. There is no white or gray undertones like some mineral tinted SPF has. It doesn't feel greasy or heavy and really does give a nice glow. I just wish it had at least a little more pigment and coverage. **I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I've been using Clinique's Brightening Tinted mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 every day for the past few weeks which is more like a true skin tint rather than a tinted sunscreen IMO The formula is very thin and lightweight, so it spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and never feels heavy on my skin. With SPF 50, it provides excellent sun protection, and even on hot, humid days when I'm sweating, it stays in place instead of sliding off. Best of all, it doesn't leave a white cast or oxidize throughout the day. It had no sunscreen scent, no scent at all. It contains niacinamide, which leaves my skin feeling hydrated, and I've noticed my skin feels softer and more moisturized since I started using it. The tint provides a light to medium coverage that helps even out my complexion and gives my skin a healthy dewy glow which is perfect for no makeup days or when I just want a little extra color. It also layers beautifully under powder without looking cakey. One thing I would note is the shade selection. My skin tone is usually light to medium, but I found the Medium shade to be a bit too dark for me. If you're between light and medium like I am, I'd recommend choosing one shade lighter. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm also happy to report that it hasn't caused any breakouts. Overall, i do really like this product and will be continuing to use it but in a lighter shade. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This tinted sunscreen from Clinique isn't bad, but it's not my favorite either. I love tinted sunscreens, as I love that they provide protection while also covering up imperfections. They're never going to achieve the same look as a foundation, but they're great for providing subtle coverage that helps to even skin tone. This particular tinted sunscreen does to that fairly well. It's a lightweight coverage, but enough to cover up some redness and pimples. I got it in the color light, which is a decent shade match for me, but I find that it pulls too far orange for my liking. I need to mix it with other products to get the right tone and color. I also have fairly oily skin and this gives me a heavy sheen that I don't really love. However, I can top it with powder and that helps to mattify the shine. Overall, it's a decent tinted sunscreen, but I'd like it better if it were less orange and less shiny. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: New contender in the tinted sunscreen game!
extraits.texte: First, let me say I was super excited to try this as tinted sunscreens have definitely been my go to lately. The consistency was a little runny, but it went on smooth and blended well. I personally found it perfect when topped off with powder to take away a bit of the shine. Used as my go to for a couple of weeks and unfortunately the niacinamide did not agree with my skin. I knew this would most likely be the case and really wish this would stop being included in so many products. If you don't have issues with that, I highly recommend this. I passed this along to my mom (whose skin is much less sensitive) and she absolutely loves it. Her skin absolutely glows with using this alone. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

extraits.titre: Very lightweight, very radiant on my skin.
extraits.texte: This was a very lightweight, non-sticky SPF. It felt great on my skin. I also like the luminosity left. I love that. It was an SPF 50. That is so hard to get in a great skin care line. This is really the first skincare tint that lasted all day on my skin. Thank you, Clinique for making a great skin care with a high SPF. I've been looking for this for a very long time. I have dry yet combo skin, and I struggle with finding this. This will be my new go to for all seasons. I have recommended this too many of my friends. I just recently went to my dermatologist and she said how great my skin looks and that she was happy that I continue to use SPF. I did tell her about the skin tint and she was very happy about it and said that she was going to start using it. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Love this product. I exclusively use tinted sunscreen as I have melasma on my face, and tinted sunscreen is the best option to further protect my skin from dark spots. The Clinique Brightening and Tinted Sunscreen goes on smooth and blends in really well, without leaving any cast. I love that it has SPF 50 so it gives good sun coverage. I put it on in the morning and reapply around noon. I will continue to buy this product moving forward. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
